name: genpark-agentic-cross-border-customs-tariff-calculator-skill
description: Autonomous Cross-Border E-Commerce Customs Tariff & Landed Cost Calculator. Classifies Harmonized System (HS) codes, evaluates de minimis duty exemption thresholds across global jurisdictions (US, EU, UK, JP, CN), computes ad valorem duties and import VAT/GST under DDP/DAP Incoterms, and generates customs manifests.

tools.name: calculate_customs_landed_cost
tools.description: Classify HS codes, check de minimis thresholds, calculate import duties and VAT/GST, and generate cross-border customs declaration manifests.
